installFailureNetworkAll.zh: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}）。请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源后重试。
installFailureNetworkAll.en: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.

installFailureNetworkHost.zh: 无法连接 {host}。GitHub 地址和 .tgz 直链不经过安装源，需要本机能直接访问它或配置代理；如果这个插件也发布到了 npm，请改填包名。
installFailureNetworkHost.en: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.

installFailurePermission.zh: 没有写入权限，无法安装
installFailurePermission.en: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed

installFailurePnpmMissing.zh: 没有找到 pnpm，无法安装
installFailurePnpmMissing.en: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed

installGitTemplateHint.zh: 请替换为实际的 Git 仓库地址
installGitTemplateHint.en: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.

installGuideIdHint.zh: 插件包名即 npm 包名（如 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名），社区插件的 README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。
installGuideIdHint.en: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.

installGuideIdTitle.zh: 填入插件 npm 包名
installGuideIdTitle.en: Enter the plugin's npm package name

installGuideSafety.zh: 请确认插件来源可信。插件在本机以你的权限运行，来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。
installGuideSafety.en: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.

installPathTemplateHint.zh: 请替换为本机插件目录的实际路径
installPathTemplateHint.en: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.

installProblemInstalled.zh: 该插件已安装。如需升级，请卸载后重新安装
installProblemInstalled.en: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again

installProblemInvalid.zh: 无法识别这个包名或地址：{reason}
installProblemInvalid.en: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}

installProblemNetwork.zh: 无法连接插件源，请检查网络后重试
installProblemNetwork.en: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again

installProblemNetworkAll.zh: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}），请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源
installProblemNetworkAll.en: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry

installProblemNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，无法作为插件安装：{reason}
installProblemNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}

installProblemNotPackage.zh: 该路径不存在或不是有效的插件包
installProblemNotPackage.en: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package

installProblemShipped.zh: 该插件随 DSH 提供，升级 DSH 即可获得新版本
installProblemShipped.en: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it

installProblemUnknown.en: The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}

installResultUnconfirmed.zh: 未收到安装结果，请核对安装状态。{reason}
installResultUnconfirmed.en: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}

installUnknownDescription.zh: 后端当前没有此安装任务。请检查插件列表后再尝试安装。
installUnknownDescription.en: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.

installUpgradeNotice.zh: 按需安装的官方插件会在版本与 DSH 不同时提供“更新”。其他插件请先卸载再安装新版。
installUpgradeNotice.en: On-demand Official plugins offer Update when their version differs from DSH. To update other plugins, uninstall and reinstall them.

overriddenNotice.zh: {name} 已保存，但被更高优先级的配置覆盖，当前未生效
overriddenNotice.en: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect

partsEmpty.zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。
partsEmpty.en: This plugin pack contains no components.

reasonAlreadyInstalled.zh: 这个包已经安装；要安装其他版本，请先卸载它
reasonAlreadyInstalled.en: This package is already installed; uninstall it before installing another version.

reasonAmbiguousInstall.zh: 无法从依赖变更中确定安装了哪一个包
reasonAmbiguousInstall.en: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.

reasonBundleInUse.zh: 其他配置仍在使用这个组合包的组件，请先停用它们
reasonBundleInUse.en: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.

reasonIncompatibleInstall.zh: 请安装与当前 DSH 兼容的插件版本。
reasonIncompatibleInstall.en: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.

reasonIncompatibleInstalled.zh: 请卸载后重新安装与当前 DSH 兼容的版本。
reasonIncompatibleInstalled.en: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.

reasonIncompatibleVersion.zh: {plugin} 与 DSH {runtime} 不兼容（要求 {requirements}），运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。
reasonIncompatibleVersion.en: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {requirements}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.

reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed.zh: 这个插件与当前 DSH 版本不兼容，运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。
reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed.en: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.

reasonInvalidSpec.zh: 请输入有效的包名或地址
reasonInvalidSpec.en: Enter a valid package name or address.

reasonManagementRequired.zh: 插件管理所需，不能停用或卸载
reasonManagementRequired.en: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.

reasonNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理
reasonNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.

reasonNotRemovable.zh: 这个包不属于当前 profile，或者是插件管理所需的组件
reasonNotRemovable.en: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.

reasonStaleApproval.zh: 待允许的安装脚本列表已变化，请重新安装以刷新
reasonStaleApproval.en: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.

reasonStopProfile.zh: 这个 profile 没有启用 HMR，正在使用的包要停止后用 dsh plugin 卸载
reasonStopProfile.en: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.

reasonUnaddressable.zh: 当前 profile 的 patch 无法唯一定位这一项
reasonUnaddressable.en: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.

registryCustomHint.zh: 填写内网或私有 npm 源地址，以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。若为需要登录的源，请把凭据放在本机的 ~/.npmrc 里。
registryCustomHint.en: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.

registryCustomInvalid.zh: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的地址
registryCustomInvalid.en: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://

registryLegend.zh: 从哪个 npm 源下载插件
registryLegend.en: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from

restartNotice.zh: 请重启 DSH 使更改生效。{reason}
restartNotice.en: Restart DSH to apply the change. {reason}

restartReasonHostModule.zh: 更改涉及 DSH 自身已加载的模块。
restartReasonHostModule.en: The change reaches modules DSH itself loaded.

restartReasonModuleComparison.zh: DSH 无法将已加载的插件与磁盘上的文件进行比较。
restartReasonModuleComparison.en: DSH could not compare the loaded plugins with their files.

restartReasonNoHmr.zh: 这个 profile 只在启动时应用更改。
restartReasonNoHmr.en: This profile applies changes only at startup.

restartReasonPackageMoved.zh: 已安装的插件包解析到了另一个目录，或者更改替换了 DSH 安装自带的包。从其他位置安装前请先卸载。
restartReasonPackageMoved.en: An installed package now resolves to another directory, or the change replaces a package the DSH installation provides. Uninstall a package before installing it from another location.

restartReasonUnmanagedPlugin.zh: 更改涉及一个不受插件列表管理的插件。
restartReasonUnmanagedPlugin.en: The change reaches a plugin running outside the plugin list.

sourceTargetSpec.zh: 当前 DSH 对应来源

sourceTargetVersion.zh: 当前 DSH 对应版本

unavailable.zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。
unavailable.en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.

emptyDescription.zh: 添加一个插件市场索引，即可在这里浏览和安装其中的插件
emptyDescription.en: Add a plugin market index to browse and install its plugins here.

exempted.zh: 此版本与当前 DSH 不兼容，但你已为它设置了兼容性豁免
exempted.en: This version is not compatible with the running DSH, but you set a compatibility exemption for it.

incompatible.zh: 此版本与当前的 DSH {runtime} 不兼容，它要求 DSH {range}
incompatible.en: This version is not compatible with the running DSH {runtime}; it requires DSH {range}.

installTrust.zh: 插件在本机以你的权限运行。请确认你信任它的来源
installTrust.en: Plugins run on this machine with your permissions. Make sure you trust where this one comes from.

noCompatibleVersion.zh: 没有与当前 DSH {runtime} 兼容的版本
noCompatibleVersion.en: No version is compatible with DSH {runtime}

readChanged.zh: 此索引在加载过程中发生了变化

readInvalid.en: This index is not in a valid format.

sourceDuplicate.en: This index source is already added.

sourceFailed.en: Could not save the index sources.

sourceInvalid.zh: 请使用 http 或 https 地址，且不要包含用户名、密码或 # 片段
sourceInvalid.en: Use an http or https address without a user name, password, or # fragment.

sourceUnavailable.zh: 当前环境无法保存索引源
sourceUnavailable.en: Index sources cannot be saved here.

sourcesDescription.zh: 插件市场以一个索引文件的 URL 提供，「发现」从这里列出的索引浏览插件
sourcesDescription.en: A plugin market is published as the URL of one index file. Discover browses the indexes listed here.

sourcesFailed.en: Could not read the index sources.

sourcesTrust.zh: 索引由第三方提供。只添加你信任的来源：其中的插件安装后以你的权限运行
sourcesTrust.en: Indexes come from third parties. Add only sources you trust: their plugins run with your permissions once installed.

error.resubmit.zh: 回答未送达，工作已继续，请再提交一次。
error.resubmit.en: The answer did not arrive before work continued; submit it again.

error.unanswered.zh: 请选择一个选项或填写自定义答案。
error.unanswered.en: Please select an option or enter a custom answer.

error.unavailable.zh: 当前无法提交，请稍候再试。
error.unavailable.en: Cannot submit right now; try again in a moment.

nav.close.zh: 收起问题面板，可从工具调用重新打开
nav.close.en: Close the panel — reopen it from the tool call

reply.label.zh: 回答先前等待中的问题

status.sent.zh: 回答已发送；面板未能关闭。
status.sent.en: Reply sent; the panel could not close.

wait.continued.en: Work continued — you can still answer

wait.paused.zh: 已暂停 · 剩余 {seconds} 秒

fileOpen.failed.zh: 无法打开“{path}”，请重试或关闭此提示
fileOpen.failed.en: Couldn’t open “{path}”. Try again or close this message.

delete.description.zh: 任务将停止触发，并连同其已保存的任务运行记录一并删除。原会话及其消息仍然保留；已排队的消息不会被撤回。
delete.description.en: This stops the task from triggering and deletes it together with its saved delivery records. The original session and its messages remain; queued messages are not withdrawn.

delivery.error.zh: 无法加载任务运行记录

delivery.label.zh: 已保存的任务运行记录

delivery.loading.zh: 正在加载任务运行记录…

delivery.notFound.en: This task is no longer available.

delivery.pruned.zh: 更早的运行记录已清理
delivery.pruned.en: Earlier delivery records have been cleared

delivery.retentionBounds.zh: 每个任务最多保留近 {days} 天内的 {records} 条运行记录。
delivery.retentionBounds.en: Each task keeps up to {records} delivery records from the last {days} days.

delivery.retentionExplanation.zh: 产生新记录时，超出范围的旧记录会自动清理。清理记录不影响任务继续运行。
delivery.retentionExplanation.en: When a new record is saved, older records outside these limits are cleared automatically. Clearing records does not stop the task.

detail.missing.zh: 任务已不可用，可能已被删除
detail.missing.en: Task unavailable. It may have been deleted.

list.empty.zh: 还没有自动化任务，在会话中创建的任务会显示在这里
list.empty.en: No tasks yet. Tasks created in your sessions appear here.

list.emptyInactive.zh: 没有已结束的自动化任务

list.noMatches.zh: 没有匹配的自动化任务

rule.cronInvalid.zh: 请输入 5 字段的 cron 表达式，例如 0 9 * * 1-5
rule.cronInvalid.en: Enter a five-field cron expression, for example 0 9 * * 1-5.

rule.error.conflict.zh: 任务在保存前已发生变化。当前显示已保存的规则，请重试
rule.error.conflict.en: This task changed before the update was saved. The row shows the saved rule; try again.

rule.error.notFound.en: This task is no longer available.

rule.error.unknown.zh: 无法确认规则是否已更新。当前显示已保存的规则
rule.error.unknown.en: Could not confirm the rule update. The row shows the saved rule.

rule.invalidTitle.zh: 请输入不超过 120 个字符的任务名称
rule.invalidTitle.en: Enter a task name of at most 120 characters.

timing.conflict.zh: 编辑期间任务已变化，草稿已保留。请在刷新后取消并重新打开编辑器，以修改最新规则
timing.conflict.en: This task changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained. Cancel and reopen after refresh to edit the latest rule.

timing.error.zh: 无法确认时间修改是否已保存。草稿已保留，请在重试前检查任务
timing.error.en: Could not confirm the timing update. Your draft is retained. Check the task before retrying.

timing.inactive.zh: 已结束的任务为只读，无法修改时间
timing.inactive.en: Inactive tasks are read-only. Their timing cannot be edited.

timing.intervalHint.hour.zh: 至少 1 小时。间隔自任务创建或上次修改规则时起计，不受时区影响
timing.intervalHint.hour.en: At least 1 hour. The interval counts from task creation or the last rule change and is independent of time zones.

timing.intervalHint.minute.zh: 至少 1 分钟。间隔自任务创建或上次修改规则时起计，不受时区影响
timing.intervalHint.minute.en: At least 1 minute. The interval counts from task creation or the last rule change and is independent of time zones.

timing.intervalHint.second.zh: 至少 60 秒。间隔自任务创建或上次修改规则时起计，不受时区影响
timing.intervalHint.second.en: At least 60 seconds. The interval counts from task creation or the last rule change and is independent of time zones.

timing.invalid.zh: 请输入有效的日期和时间，或检查时间字段
timing.invalid.en: Enter a valid date and time, or check the timing fields.

timing.invalidInterval.zh: 请输入至少 1 分钟的间隔
timing.invalidInterval.en: Enter an interval of at least 1 minute.

timing.invalidInterval.hour.zh: 请输入至少 1 小时的间隔
timing.invalidInterval.hour.en: Enter an interval of at least 1 hour.

timing.invalidInterval.minute.zh: 请输入至少 1 分钟的间隔
timing.invalidInterval.minute.en: Enter an interval of at least 1 minute.

timing.invalidInterval.second.zh: 请输入至少 60 秒的间隔
timing.invalidInterval.second.en: Enter an interval of at least 60 seconds.

timing.invalidZone.zh: 请输入有效的 IANA 时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai
timing.invalidZone.en: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai.

timing.notFound.zh: 此任务当前不可用，草稿已保留。请取消以关闭编辑器
timing.notFound.en: This task is no longer available. Your draft is retained; cancel to close the editor.

timing.notFuture.zh: 请选择未来的日期和时间
timing.notFuture.en: Choose a date and time in the future.

timing.subagentSession.zh: 此会话属于子 agent，永远不会收到投递的提醒
timing.subagentSession.en: This session belongs to a sub-agent, which never receives delivered reminders.

timing.zoneNoStored.zh: 单次任务只保存触发时刻，不保存时区；日期和时间按所选时区换算
timing.zoneNoStored.en: A one-time task stores only its target moment, not a time zone. The date and time are interpreted in the selected time zone.

timing.zoneSearch.zh: 搜索 UTC 偏移、IANA 标识或城市
timing.zoneSearch.en: Search by UTC offset, IANA ID, or city

filter.context.en: Parent context of a matching record
filter.context.zh: 匹配记录的父级上下文

filter.failed.en: Type suggestions could not be loaded.

filter.help.en: Contains matching (*keyword*). Enter confirms; Esc cancels.
filter.help.zh: 默认包含匹配（*关键词*）；Enter 确认，Esc 取消。

filter.noCandidates.en: No suggestions. You can still apply this keyword.
filter.noCandidates.zh: 没有匹配候选，仍可确认当前关键词。

picker.instructions.en: Hover in the main Chat to preview, then click to select. Esc cancels.
picker.instructions.zh: 在左侧 Chat 中悬停预览，点击选取；Esc 取消。

picker.noChat.en: Open this Session in the main Chat before picking.
picker.noChat.zh: 请先在主区域打开当前 Session 的 Chat。

picker.noMatch.en: No matching record in this table. Pick another element or press Esc to cancel.
picker.noMatch.zh: 当前表格没有匹配记录，请选择其他元素或按 Esc 取消。

picker.pick.en: Pick an element in Chat View
picker.pick.zh: 在对话面板中选取元素

tab.description.en: Analyze raw logs and grouped chat messages for the current session in the sidebar.
tab.description.zh: 在侧边栏分析当前会话原始日志和聊天分组数据

table.rawError.en: This record could not be serialized. Select another record to continue.
table.rawError.zh: 无法序列化这条记录，可以选择其他记录继续查看。

table.removed.en: This record was removed or settled. Select a current record.
table.removed.zh: 该记录已移除或结算，请选择当前记录。

table.resizeDetails.zh: 调整原始数据面板高度

dialog.commandFailed.zh: 无法启动 Session 导出。
dialog.commandFailed.en: Could not start the Session export.

dialog.preparingDescription.zh: 正在准备包含当前 Session、子 Session 和附件的 ZIP 文件。
dialog.preparingDescription.en: Preparing a ZIP containing this Session, its sub-Sessions, and attachments.

dialog.successDescription.zh: 浏览器正在下载 Session ZIP 文件。
dialog.successDescription.en: The browser is downloading the Session ZIP.

connection.reconnect.zh: 连接异常，点击立即重连

connection.restart.zh: 连接中断，正在重试，点击立即重连

desktop.update.checkFailed.zh: 检查更新失败，请稍后重试。
desktop.update.checkFailed.en: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.

desktop.update.checkNetworkFailed.zh: 检查更新失败，请检查网络连接后重试。
desktop.update.checkNetworkFailed.en: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.update.downloadDetail.zh:
正在下载更新：{percent}%
目标版本：{version}

desktop.update.downloadFailed.en: Could not download the update. Please try again.

desktop.update.downloadNetworkFailed.zh: 下载更新失败，请检查网络连接后重试。
desktop.update.downloadNetworkFailed.en: Could not download the update. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.update.installFailed.zh: 安装更新失败，请稍后重试。
desktop.update.installFailed.en: Could not install the update. Please try again later.

desktop.update.installNetworkFailed.zh: 安装更新失败，请检查网络连接后重试。
desktop.update.installNetworkFailed.en: Could not install the update. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.update.stopFailed.zh: 未能安全停止任务，更新尚未安装，请稍后重试。
desktop.update.stopFailed.en: Could not safely stop the tasks. The update has not been installed. Please try again later.

desktop.update.tasksChanged.zh: 有新任务开始运行，请重新确认是否停止任务并更新。
desktop.update.tasksChanged.en: New tasks have started. Confirm again to stop the tasks and update.

desktop.update.tasksUnavailable.zh: 无法确认任务状态，请在工作区就绪后重试更新。
desktop.update.tasksUnavailable.en: Task status is unavailable. Try updating again when the workspace is ready.

developerTools.description.zh: 开启后，显示轨迹、本轮代码差异，可选择完整的 Agent 预设切换
developerTools.description.en: Shows trajectory, code diffs, and all Agent presets

developerTools.error.en: Could not save. Please try again.

hostRelease.description.zh: 服务版本已变化，本页面已暂停热更新，刷新后加载新版本。
hostRelease.description.en: The service version changed. This page paused live updates; reload to load the new version.

hostRelease.reload.en: Reload to load the new version

browserDescription.en: , then open it in your browser to finish signing in.

failed.en: Could not complete the operation. Try again.

loginDescription.en: Sign in to your DeepSeek account or add an API Key to get started. Your projects and files are stored locally.
loginDescription.zh: 登录 DeepSeek 账号，或添加 API Key，即可开始使用。你的项目和文件保存在本地。

modelSignInRequired.en: Model unavailable. Please sign in and try again.
modelSignInRequired.zh: 当前模型暂不可用，请登录后再试

noResponse.en: Something went wrong. Please check your network connection and try again.
noResponse.zh: 操作未完成，可能是网络异常，请检查你的网络状况后重试

onboardingCompactDescription.en: See just the results in a clean, simple interface
onboardingCompactDescription.zh: 只看结果，保持界面简洁明了

onboardingCreditDescription.en: DeepSeek Harness charges credits based on the tokens used by models and tools. Add credits in advance to keep your tasks running without interruption. Your balance is only used while the agent is working on a task.
onboardingCreditDescription.zh: DeepSeek Harness 执行任务时，会根据模型与工具使用的 token 量扣除额度。请提前添加额度，避免任务在执行过程中被迫中断。你的余额只会在 Agent 实际执行任务时消耗。

onboardingDetailedDescription.en: See the full process for easier debugging and troubleshooting
onboardingDetailedDescription.zh: 查看完整工作过程，方便调试和排查问题

onboardingDevelopmentDescription.en: Edit code, debug issues, run commands, manage project files, and more

guideCordisExplanation.zh:
### 可以创造什么

创造模式具备标准任务工具，并增加运行时检查、持久化插件管理，以及 Cordis 插件和 Agent 预设的开发指引。可以编写插件来添加功能或界面，也可以组合工具和提示词，创建适合特定任务的模式。

### 插件与模式的关系

插件为 DSH 增加能力，例如工具、服务连接或界面入口。模式是一份 Agent 预设，用来选择任务可用的工具，并约定 Agent 的工作方式。自定义模式中也可以使用自己开发的插件。

### 怎样让成果生效

可以要求 Agent 完成安装并验证实际效果。插件可能即时加载，也可能需要重启，取决于修改内容；新建的模式在创建新任务时选择。
guideCordisExplanation.en:
### What you can create

Creator mode includes the standard task tools plus runtime inspection, persistent plugin management, and guidance for authoring Cordis plugins and agent presets. It can create a plugin that adds a capability or UI, or a preset that combines tools and prompts for a particular job.

### Plugins and modes

A plugin adds capabilities to DSH, such as a tool, a service connection, or a UI entry. A mode is an agent preset that selects tools and defines how the agent works in a task. A plugin can be included in a custom preset.

### How the result takes effect

Ask the agent to install and verify the result, not just generate source code. A plugin may load immediately or require a restart, depending on what it changes. A newly created preset is selected when starting a new task.

guideCordisIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「创造模式」，说明希望增加什么能力、从哪里使用，以及怎样验证效果。
guideCordisIntro.en: Choose Creator mode for a new task. Describe the capability you want, where it should appear, and how you will verify it.

guideCordisUsage.zh:
### 添加一个界面

> 帮我写一个 DSH 插件，在侧栏增加「项目笔记」入口，列出当前工作区的 Markdown 文件，点击后能预览内容。完成安装并验证页面能打开。

预期产出：带侧栏入口和预览页的插件，以及仍需完成的生效步骤。

### 添加一个工具

> 写一个插件，提供读取项目测试报告、汇总失败用例的工具。注册工具，并用一份示例报告验证调用结果。

预期产出：可调用的新工具，以及一次示例调用的验证结果。

### 创建自己的模式

> 基于标准模式创建「代码审查」模式，优先检查潜在错误和测试缺口，指出文件与行号，修改文件前先询问我。保存成可选择的预设。

预期产出：可在新任务中选择的自定义模式。审查要求用于指导 Agent，实际可执行的操作仍由权限设置决定。
guideCordisUsage.en:
### Add a UI

> Create a DSH plugin that adds a project notes entry to the sidebar. Let me browse the Markdown files in this workspace and preview a selected note. Install it and verify that the page opens.

Expected output: an installed plugin with a working entry and preview page, plus any remaining activation steps.

### Add a tool

> Create a plugin with a tool that reads this project’s test report and summarizes the failed tests. Register it and verify it with a sample report.

Expected output: a plugin with a callable tool and a verified sample call.

### Create my own mode

> Create a “Code review” mode based on Standard mode. Have it prioritize potential bugs and test gaps, cite file paths and lines, and ask before modifying files. Save it as a selectable preset.

Expected output: a custom preset for new tasks. These review instructions guide the agent; permission settings determine which actions it can execute.

guideMinimalExplanation.zh:
### 保留哪些能力

提供持久 Shell 和 read_image 工具，并使用固定系统提示词。读取图片需要支持图片输入的模型。上下文压力达到阈值时自动压缩较早历史；Agent 空闲时可输入 /compact 手动压缩。内置预设不加载 Skills、计划，也不注入标准运行时上下文。

### 什么时候选

适合作为实验和对照测试的基线。Agent 仍能通过终端命令读写文件、运行脚本，但缺少管理长任务的内置辅助能力。工具少，不代表对新手更容易。
guideMinimalExplanation.en:
### What is included

One persistent shell tool, read_image, and a fixed system prompt. Image reading requires an image-capable model. Older history is compacted automatically under context pressure; use /compact while the agent is idle to compact it manually. The built-in preset does not load Skills, planning, or the standard runtime context.

### When to choose it

Use it as a baseline for experiments and comparisons. It can still read files and execute scripts through shell commands, but offers fewer built-in ways to manage a long task. Fewer tools does not necessarily make it easier for a beginner.

guideMinimalIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「极简模式」。做对照测试时，保持模型、权限、任务输入和工作区起始状态一致。
guideMinimalIntro.en: Choose Minimal mode for a new task. For a comparison, hold the model, permissions, input, and starting workspace state constant across runs.

guideMinimalUsage.zh:
### 对比基础修复表现

> 运行这个项目的测试，找出失败原因，做最小修复，再运行相关测试并报告结果。

分别用标准模式和极简模式，从相同的工作区状态执行这条任务，对比完成情况、工具调用和最终修改。极简模式会通过终端命令完成这些操作。
guideMinimalUsage.en:
### Compare performance on a small bug fix

> Run the tests for this project, find the cause of the failure, and make the smallest fix. Run the relevant tests again and report the result.

Run the same task separately in Standard and Minimal modes from the same starting state. Compare task completion, tool calls, and the resulting changes. Minimal mode performs the work through terminal commands.

guidePtcExplanation.zh:
### 怎样调用工具

PTC 是 Programmatic Tool Calling，即通过程序调用工具。当前内置预设让 Agent 通过 run_code 编写 TypeScript 程序，使用生成的工具 SDK 发起调用。程序可以组织循环、条件判断、错误处理，以及适合并发执行的调用。

### 哪些结果交给模型

工具返回的数据先交给程序，经过筛选、计算或合并，再通过输出或返回值交给模型；图片结果会另行附加。程序中的工具调用仍会被记录，也仍受工具权限约束。

### 与标准模式的区别

两种模式都能编程、批量处理文件。标准模式直接向模型提供各个工具；PTC 让模型用代码组织工具调用。当前 PTC 预设未启用 workflow 工具。速度和 token 用量取决于具体任务与结果处理方式。
guidePtcExplanation.en:
### How tools are called

PTC means Programmatic Tool Calling. In this built-in preset, the agent uses run_code to write a TypeScript program that calls tools through a generated SDK. The program can use loops, conditions, error handling, and concurrent calls where appropriate.

### What reaches the model

Tool results first reach the program, which can filter and combine them. The model receives what the program prints or returns; image results are attached separately. Nested tool calls are still recorded and remain subject to tool permissions.

### Compared with Standard mode

Both modes can handle coding and batch tasks. Standard mode exposes individual tools directly; PTC organizes tool calls in code. The current PTC preset leaves the workflow tool disabled. Speed and token use depend on the task and how the program handles its results.

guidePtcIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「PTC 模式」，说明输入文件、处理规则和输出格式。代码由 Agent 编写。
guidePtcIntro.en: Choose PTC mode when starting a new task. Specify the input files, processing rules, and output format. The agent writes the code.

guidePtcUsage.zh:
### 批量检查配置文件

> 检查 configs/ 下所有 JSON 文件，按照 schema.json 找出缺失字段和不合法的值。每个问题写成 CSV 中的一行；读取失败的文件也记入报告，继续检查其余文件。保留原文件。

预期产出：问题汇总和一份 CSV 报告。程序可以对多份文件执行相同检查，处理单个文件的失败，再汇总结果。

### 汇总错误日志

> 分析 logs/ 下的日志，按服务和错误类型统计次数，列出出现最多的十类错误，每类保留一条示例。完整统计另存为 CSV。

预期产出：高频错误摘要和完整统计表。中间数据可以先在程序中聚合，再把汇总交给模型。
guidePtcUsage.en:
### Check a set of configuration files

> Check all JSON files in configs/. List missing required fields and invalid values against schema.json. Save a CSV with one row per issue. Include unreadable files in the report and keep checking the rest. Leave the original files unchanged.

Expected output: an issue summary and a CSV report. The program can repeat the same checks, handle individual failures, and collect the results.

### Summarize error logs

> Analyze the log files in logs/. Group errors by service and error type. Show the ten most frequent groups and one example from each. Save the full counts to a CSV.

Expected output: the top error groups and a complete count table. Intermediate data can be aggregated in the program before the summary reaches the model.

guideStandardExplanation.zh:
### 工作方式

Agent 直接调用工具来读写文件、检索资料和执行终端命令。包含 Skills、计划、目标、子 Agent、工作流和上下文压缩等能力。

### 什么时候选

日常编程、文件处理和资料整理可以从这里开始。标准模式也能编写脚本、批量处理文件；PTC 改变的是工具调用方式，批量任务并不必须使用 PTC。
guideStandardExplanation.en:
### How it works

The agent calls tools directly to read and edit files, search, and run terminal commands. It includes Skills, planning, goals, subagents, workflows, and context compaction.

### When to choose it

Start here for everyday coding, file work, and research. Standard mode can also write scripts and process files in batches. PTC changes how tool calls are organized; it is not required for batch tasks.

guideStandardIntro.zh: 新建任务时选择「标准模式」，说明要完成什么、相关文件在哪里，以及怎样判断任务完成。
guideStandardIntro.en: Choose Standard mode when starting a new task. Describe what you want to accomplish, point to the relevant files, and explain how to check the result.

guideStandardUsage.zh:
### 修复一个问题

> 搜索表单连续提交两次后，结果会消失。请定位原因、修复问题并运行相关测试，最后说明原因和修改内容。

预期产出：代码修改、相关测试结果，以及问题原因说明。

### 整理项目资料

> 阅读项目中的 Markdown 记录，整理已经达成的结论和仍待确认的问题，并附上对应文件链接。

预期产出：一份带来源引用的总结，方便回到原文核对。
guideStandardUsage.en:
### Fix a bug

> Find out why submitting the search form twice makes the results disappear. Fix it and run the relevant tests. Explain the cause and what changed.

Expected output: a code change, the relevant test results, and an explanation of the cause.

### Organize project notes

> Read the Markdown notes in this project. Summarize the agreed decisions and open questions, with links to the source files.

Expected output: a summary with references that you can check against the original notes.

welcomeBody.zh:
DeepSeek Harness 目前的 0.2 版本仍处于预览阶段，还有许多地方需要持续改进和打磨，希望听取广大开发者和用户的反馈建议。现在，新的桌面端面向广泛用户，开发者相关的进阶功能可在配置中开启使用。预计 DeepSeek Harness 的产品功能以及插件 API 都会继续快速迭代、持续演化，并逐渐趋于稳定。

我们期待与全球用户和开发者一起，在开源、可复用、可组合的基础设施之上，共同探索智能上限。欢迎大家用 DeepSeek Harness 将想法变成现实，与社区一起丰富插件生态。
welcomeBody.en:
DeepSeek Harness 0.2 is still in preview, and many areas need continued improvement and refinement. We welcome feedback and suggestions from all developers and users. The new desktop app now targets a broad range of users, while developer-related advanced features can be enabled in the settings. DeepSeek Harness’s product features and plugin APIs are expected to continue rapid iteration and evolution, and will gradually stabilize over time.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence together with users and developers around the world, building on open-source, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome everyone to bring their ideas to life with DeepSeek Harness and participate in the community to enrich the plugin ecosystem.

inputFull.zh: 输入缓冲区已满，请重新连接后重试。
inputFull.en: The input buffer is full. Reconnect and try again.

invalidOutput.zh: 终端画面传输异常，请重新连接。
invalidOutput.en: The terminal screen could not be received. Reconnect to recover it.

missingTerminal.zh: 此终端已不存在，请新建终端。
missingTerminal.en: This terminal no longer exists. Open a new terminal.

terminalLimit.zh: 终端数量已达上限，请关闭不用的终端后重试。已退出的终端也计入数量。
terminalLimit.en: The terminal limit has been reached. Close unused terminals and try again. Exited terminals also count toward the limit.

branch.collapse.zh: 收起 {label} 的下级子智能体

branch.expand.zh: 展开 {label} 的下级子智能体

readonly.body.zh: 父会话当前不在线，重新打开父会话后即可继续发送消息。
readonly.body.en: The parent session is offline; reopen it to continue sending messages.

readonly.oneShot.body.zh: 一次性任务不支持后续消息，可在这里查看完整执行记录。
readonly.oneShot.body.en: One-shot tasks do not accept follow-ups; review the full execution record here.

readonly.title.en: This subagent is read-only for now

readonly.unknown.body.zh: 读取子会话后才能确定是否可继续。
readonly.unknown.body.en: Read the child session to determine whether it can be continued.

block.openSummary.zh: 打开第 {index} 个块的工具调用概述

details.resizeTitle.zh: 拖动调整大小；双击恢复默认值。
details.resizeTitle.en: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.

layout.compactionInterrupted.zh: 上下文压缩在完成前被中断。

layout.systemPromptAndToolsUpdated.zh: 系统提示词和工具已更新

layout.toolsChanged.zh: 新增 {added} 个，移除 {removed} 个

record.systemPromptMissing.zh: 本次请求没有系统提示词
record.systemPromptMissing.en: No system prompt in this request

timeline.overviewAria.zh: 时间线概览；水平拖动可聚焦事件
timeline.overviewAria.en: Timeline overview; drag horizontally to focus events

timing.firstTokenUnavailable.zh: 首 token 时间不可用

timing.outputTokensUnavailable.zh: 输出 token 数不可用

cloud.zh: 音频将发送至所选云端服务。
cloud.en: Audio will be sent to the selected cloud service.

conflict.zh: 草稿已被修改。识别文字已保留，可在当前光标位置插入。
conflict.en: Your draft changed. The transcript is preserved and can be inserted at the current cursor.

deviceMissing.zh: 麦克风不可用，请选择其他输入设备
deviceMissing.en: Microphone unavailable. Choose another input device.

download.certificate.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：安全连接的证书校验失败。

download.dns.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：无法解析下载地址。
download.dns.en: Cannot download {resource}: the download address could not be resolved.

download.http.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：下载服务返回 HTTP {status}。
download.http.en: Cannot download {resource}: the download service returned HTTP {status}.

download.integrity.zh: {resource} 下载不完整或文件校验失败。
download.integrity.en: The download of {resource} is incomplete or failed verification.

download.network.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：连接下载服务失败。
download.network.en: Cannot download {resource}: connection to the download service failed.

download.storage.zh: 无法保存 {resource}：磁盘空间不足或没有写入权限。
download.storage.en: Cannot save {resource}: insufficient disk space or write permission.

downloadAdvice.certificate.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的系统时间、受信任证书和代理设置后重试。
downloadAdvice.certificate.en: Check the system clock, trusted certificates and proxy settings on the machine running DSH, then retry.

downloadAdvice.dns.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的 DNS 和代理设置，确认可以解析下载来源的域名后重试。
downloadAdvice.dns.en: Check DNS and proxy settings on the machine running DSH. Confirm that it can resolve the download source domain, then retry.

downloadAdvice.http.zh: 请确认下载地址可用、代理可正常连接下载服务，或稍后重试。
downloadAdvice.http.en: Confirm that the download address is available and the proxy can reach the download service, or retry later.

downloadAdvice.integrity.zh: 请重试下载。已完成并通过校验的其他文件会保留。
downloadAdvice.integrity.en: Retry the download. Other completed and verified files are retained.

downloadAdvice.network.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器能否访问下载来源及其模型下载服务；如需代理，请在该机器上配置后重试。
downloadAdvice.network.en: Check that the machine running DSH can reach the download source and its model download services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed, then retry.

downloadAdvice.storage.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的剩余磁盘空间，以及模型目录的写入权限后重试。
downloadAdvice.storage.en: Check available disk space and write permission for the model directory on the machine running DSH, then retry.

downloadAdvice.timeout.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络或代理连接，稍后重试。已下载并通过校验的文件会保留。
downloadAdvice.timeout.en: Check the network or proxy connection on the machine running DSH, then retry later. Verified downloaded files are retained.

downloadAdvice.unknown.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络、磁盘空间和模型目录权限后重试。
downloadAdvice.unknown.en: Check the network, disk space and model directory permissions on the machine running DSH, then retry.

interrupted.en: Recording was interrupted. Please try again.

local.zh: 音频在运行 DSH 的机器上识别。需要下载模型时，请确保该机器能访问所选下载源及其文件服务。如需代理，请在该机器上配置。
local.en: Audio is recognized on the machine running DSH. If models need downloading, that machine must be able to reach the selected source and its file services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed.

permission.zh: 麦克风权限未开启，请在浏览器和系统设置中允许访问。
permission.en: Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings.

preparation.cancelled.zh: 准备已取消，已完成的下载会保留。
preparation.cancelled.en: Preparation cancelled. Completed downloads are retained.

preparation.standby.zh: 本地资源已准备，录音时自动唤醒。
preparation.standby.en: Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer.

preparation.unprepared.zh: 首次使用需要下载本地识别模型。
preparation.unprepared.en: First use downloads the local recognition models.

setup.diskValue.zh: 建议预留约 {gb} GB，包含模型、运行时和下载缓存
setup.diskValue.en: Allow about {gb} GB for models, runtime, and download caches

setup.estimateNote.zh: 以上为估算；网络较慢时可能更久。已下载的资源会复用，默认在闲置后释放模型内存。
setup.estimateNote.en: These are estimates; slow networks may take longer. Downloads are reused; idle models release memory by default.

setup.local.zh: 将在运行 DSH 的机器上下载本地模型，无需安装 Python 或编译工具。
setup.local.en: Local models will be downloaded to the machine running DSH. No Python or compiler is required.

setup.memoryValue.zh: 模型加载后约 {gb} GB，识别时可能更高
setup.memoryValue.en: About {gb} GB with the model loaded; recognition may use more

setup.timeValue.zh: 参考 {min}–{max} 分钟，取决于网络和机器性能
setup.timeValue.en: Allow roughly {min}–{max} minutes, depending on the network and machine

setupPrompt.body.zh: 语音输入插件已开启。首次使用需要在本机下载并准备识别模型，请前往插件详情页查看空间、内存和时间说明，再开始安装。
setupPrompt.body.en: Voice input is enabled. First use requires downloading and preparing local recognition models. Open the plugin details to review disk space, memory and time estimates before starting setup.

setupPrompt.title.zh: 使用语音输入前需要安装
setupPrompt.title.en: Set up voice input before recording

setupPrompt.unavailableBody.zh: 请前往语音插件详情页查看识别服务状态、准备进度或错误信息
setupPrompt.unavailableBody.en: Open the voice plugin details to check recognition status, preparation progress, or errors.

sourceAutoHelp.zh: 优先使用响应较快的源，下载失败时自动尝试其他源。
sourceAutoHelp.en: Prefer the first responding source and try another if a download fails.

sourceManualHelp.zh: 仅从所选源下载；已下载并通过校验的文件会复用。
sourceManualHelp.en: Download only from the selected source. Verified downloaded files are reused.

tooLarge.zh: 录音超过服务限制，请缩短录音后重试。
tooLarge.en: The recording exceeds the service limit. Try a shorter recording.

unavailable.zh: 当前浏览器不支持录音，请使用支持麦克风的浏览器。
unavailable.en: This browser cannot record audio. Use a browser with microphone support.

archive.confirm.desc.zh: “{title}”仍有正在进行的工作。归档会先停止这些工作；之后可在侧栏筛选“全部对话（显示已归档）”中恢复会话，被停止的工作不会自动继续。
archive.confirm.desc.en: “{title}” still has work in progress. Archiving stops it first; you can restore the session later from the “All conversations (show archived)” filter in the sidebar, and the stopped work will not resume on its own.

defaultWorkspace.failed.zh: 无法创建默认工作区，请通过“选择工作区”选择文件夹
defaultWorkspace.failed.en: Unable to create default workspace. Use Choose workspace to select a folder.

delete.desc.zh: 将把“{name}”从工作区列表中移除。文件夹与会话记录会保留，其会话将显示在“未分组”下。
delete.desc.en: This removes “{name}” from the workspace list. The folder and session logs will be kept. Its sessions will appear under Ungrouped.

draft.initializationFailed.zh: 暂时无法填入草稿，请稍后重试
draft.initializationFailed.en: Could not fill the draft. Please try again shortly.

search.hasMore.zh: 仅显示前 {n} 条结果，请缩小搜索范围。
search.hasMore.en: Showing the first {n} results. Narrow your search.

shortcut.directoryBusy.zh: 正在选择或添加工作区

shortcut.forkFailed.en: Could not fork the session. Try again.

shortcut.noCompletedTurn.zh: 当前会话没有已结束的轮次
shortcut.noCompletedTurn.en: This session has no completed turn

toast.archivedNotOpenable.zh: 已归档对话暂时无法查看，请取消归档后查看
toast.archivedNotOpenable.en: Archived sessions cannot be opened. Unarchive it to view.

toast.forkRequiresOpen.zh: 请先打开原会话完成迁移，再创建分支
toast.forkRequiresOpen.en: Open the original session to complete migration before creating a branch.

toast.stoppedAndArchived.en: Session stopped and archived. You can

toast.unpinFailed.zh: 取消置顶失败，请稍后重试
